protocol.near_range: raw decoder radial 2.5 m filter is not a 2.5 m forward-distance threshold
protocol.forward_tolerance: max(2 m, 3% of target min-forward) + half target forward extent
protocol.vertical_tolerance: 0.5 m maximum gap between observed vertical extents
protocol.assignment: maximum-cardinality one-to-one; all valid assignments retained as bounds
protocol.population: positive-return annotation rows within range; gauge certainty kept separately
protocol.unmatched: unresolved unless annotations explicitly declare exhaustive_obstacles=true
protocol.held: 90% of supported rows at that distance or nearer; assignment lower bound
